The actuator replacement must happen first (with proper lockout of four isolation points), then the cleaning with three rinse samples under quality hold, and any personnel entry during cleaning requires supplied-air respirators and continuous atmospheric monitoring. All of this must be completed by Sunday at 18:00.

I'm prepared to authorize entry, but only with all of these controls in place. Let me formalize my decision now.

Pending maintenance note for the actuator replacement must be entered into the central work-order system today for formal tracking.
Industrial hygiene report must receive final sign-off and be posted at the vessel before entry begins.
Batch file documenting the allergen-containing previous batch and three-rinse-sample requirement must be attached to the weekend work package.
Scheduling email confirming the Sunday 18:00 release deadline must be copied into the maintenance calendar.

A detailed timeline mapping all steps — actuator replacement, IH equipment staging and verification, internal cleaning entry, three rinse samples, lab turnaround, and buffer for one re-cleaning cycle — must be developed and confirmed feasible before entry begins.
